acceptance: Power-test per-query timers start after query text is generated, for TPC-H and TPC-DS.
Test asserts get_query is not called inside the timed window.
Changelog notes that power-test times from earlier versions include generation.
description: benchbox/core/tpch/power_test.py:328 starts query_start before benchmark.get_query(...) at :344, which runs a qgen subprocess (tpch/queries.py:66) plus dialect translation. tpcds/power_test.py:255-276 does the same with dsqgen. Throughput tests pregenerate text (tpch/throughput_test.py:620 _resolve_query_text), so the two tests time different work, and power numbers carry ~10-50 ms of client work per query, which skews fast engines. Generate query text before the timer starts.
